title: Pelvic-floor impact check-in (PFIQ-7)
description: The 7-item short-form Pelvic Floor Impact Questionnaire. Each of seven life-impact prompts is asked separately for the bladder, the bowel, and the vagina/pelvis, producing three subscales (UIQ-7, CRAIQ-7, POPIQ-7). Used at baseline and at 3-month follow-up for patients with prolapse, urinary incontinence, or anorectal symptoms.

items.text: How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your household chores (cooking, housecleaning, laundry)?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your physical recreation such as walking, swimming, or other exercise?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your entertainment activities (movies, concerts, etc.)?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your ability to travel by car or bus more than 30 minutes from home?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your participating in social activities outside your home?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms affect your emotional health (nervousness, depression, etc.)?
How much do bladder or urine symptoms make you feel frustrated?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your household chores (cooking, housecleaning, laundry)?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your physical recreation such as walking, swimming, or other exercise?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your entertainment activities (movies, concerts, etc.)?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your ability to travel by car or bus more than 30 minutes from home?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your participating in social activities outside your home?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms affect your emotional health (nervousness, depression, etc.)?
How much do bowel or rectal symptoms make you feel frustrated?
How much does feeling pressure, bulging, or fullness in the vagina or pelvis affect your household chores?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging affect your physical recreation such as walking, swimming, or other exercise?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging affect your entertainment activities (movies, concerts, etc.)?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging affect your ability to travel by car or bus more than 30 minutes from home?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging affect your participating in social activities outside your home?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging affect your emotional health (nervousness, depression, etc.)?
How much does pelvic pressure/bulging make you feel frustrated?

scoring.note: Each subscale (UIQ-7, CRAIQ-7, POPIQ-7) is scored as the mean of its 7 items × (100/3) to produce a 0–100 subscale score. PFIQ-7 total = sum of the three subscale scores (range 0–300). Lower = better.

interpretation_bands.label: minimal_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Pelvic-floor symptoms are having a minimal impact on your life right now.

interpretation_bands.label: moderate_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Pelvic-floor symptoms are having a moderate impact on your life.

interpretation_bands.label: substantial_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Pelvic-floor symptoms are substantially affecting your daily life.

interpretation_bands.label: severe_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Pelvic-floor symptoms are severely affecting your quality of life.

thresholds.message: PFIQ-7 total ≥125 — pelvic-floor symptoms substantially affecting life. Evaluation for prolapse / urogyn intervention warranted.
CRAIQ-7 subscale ≥80 — anorectal symptoms dominant; colorectal coordination may be needed.
PFIQ-7 total has worsened by ≥30 points compared to baseline. Recommend earlier follow-up.

citation: Barber MD, Walters MD, Bump RC. Short forms of two condition-specific quality-of-life questionnaires for women with pelvic floor disorders (PFDI-20 and PFIQ-7). Am J Obstet Gynecol 2005;193(1):103-13. PMID: 16021067
